title: Manually displayed episode list differed from the hash-bound R0 plan
impact: The prior chat summary showed incorrect episode filenames. Fail-closed revalidation occurred before any episode transfer, so zero incorrect files were downloaded and no private or tracked artifact was contaminated.
containment: Transfer was paused; remote dataset versions, manifest hashes, plan hash and canonical selected_items were revalidated. The planner hash implementation was inspected and proved to bind every selected filename and declared byte count.
root_cause: The human-readable list was manually transcribed instead of being generated directly from the canonical plan artifact.
corrective_action: Acquire only the selected_items embedded in the approved plan whose SHA-256 is eee76a723f8e9d89c29ea34da4b84765128c5eba8d452893a311b3fc5b7d6934 and record an exact-set acquisition audit.
regression_test: The acquisition verifier rejects missing, extra, partial, size-drifted, malformed, nonterminal, misaligned or unresolvable files. The completed audit found 20 expected files, 20 observed files, zero extras, zero missing files and audit SHA-256 603df727f237982ea64e70b0f5f4ff5e497fdbf8f2c20188007077df284f4bfe.
prevention: Future approval displays must be rendered from the immutable plan artifact and include its recalculated hash; manually maintained filename lists are non-authoritative.
